Messages: IMPORTANT The Solemnity 'The Nativity of Saint John the Baptist' coincides with the Solemnity 'Most Sacred Heart of Jesus' in the year 2022. We should ask the Congregation for Divine Worship what to do about this!

IMPORTANT Seeing that the Solemnity 'The Nativity of Saint John the Baptist' coincides with the Solemnity 'Most Sacred Heart of Jesus' in the year 2022, it has been anticipated by one day as per Decree of the Congregation for Divine Worship.
'Christmas' falls on a Sunday in the year 2022, therefore the Feast 'Holy Family of Jesus, Mary and Joseph' is celebrated on December 30th rather than on the Sunday after Christmas.
'12th Sunday of Ordinary Time' is superseded by the celebration with precedence over solemnities 'Corpus Christi' in the year 2022.

The FEAST 'Saint Thomas the Apostle', added in the Editio Typica 1970 of the Roman Missal since the year 1970 (Apostolic Constitution Missale Romanum) and usually celebrated on July 3rd, is suppressed by the Sunday '14th Sunday of Ordinary Time' in the year 2022.
